guide.title: How to create an assignment
guide.description: Follow these steps from creating the draft to publishing it for students.

1.title: Start with assignment details
1.description: Create a draft first. Enter a clear assignment name, select the grade, and add a short description so the purpose is easy to understand.
1.tip1: Use a name students will recognize.
1.tip2: Choose the grade that matches the target class.

2.title: Choose the students
2.description: Select one or more classes that should receive the assignment. Check the target carefully before publishing.
2.tip2: Only choose classes that should actually receive this assignment.

3.title: Set the schedule
3.description: Set the due date and decide whether students can see answers after submitting. The assignment remains a draft until you are ready to publish it.
3.tip1: Make sure the due date is in the future when publishing.
3.tip2: Decide the answer-visibility rule before students start.

4.title: Add questions
4.description: After creating the draft, open the assignment detail page and build its question set. You can add existing questions or create a new question.
4.tip1: Review the question wording and answer options.
4.tip2: Make sure the question set matches the assignment goal.

5.title: Review and publish
5.description: Review the assignment information, target classes, schedule, and question set before publishing.
5.tip1: Check all target classes one last time.
5.tip2: Confirm questions and due date before publishing.
